title: Launch of Sputnik, 4 October 1957 (CIA U-2 history, Chapter 4)
description: Dark night-time photograph of a rocket launch with a bright exhaust plume, captioned "Launch of Sputnik, 4 October 1957." The photo sits above Chapter 4 text (page 160) discussing Khrushchev's ICBM claims, the failed Titan launch and the missile-gap debate within the US intelligence community.
